scraped.scraped_description: A phonebank platform you & your volunteers will love. Turbo Phonebank turns any Google Sheet into a phonebank with 2-tap calling, integrated text messaging, and a caller-friendly interface (for free).

name: Turbo Phonebank
tagline: A free phonebank platform that turns Google Sheets into phonebanks and textbanks with 2-tap calling
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
failure_modes: API rate limiting from Google Sheets
contributor_governance: Individual project - no formal contributor governance
political_relevance_summary: Turbo Phonebank addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. A free phonebank platform that turns Google Sheets into phonebanks and textbanks with 2-tap calling.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizing, mobilization, or campaign activities

generalizability_notes: Limited to United States context currently; approach could potentially be replicated in similar jurisdictions with adaptation to local data sources and regulations.
